newsitem.title: USA: Entergy says any bid talks are preliminary.
newsitem.headline: Entergy says any bid talks are preliminary.

text.p: Entergy Corp on Tuesday declined comment on a possible bid for London Electricity Plc, saying that any talks by the company with another party were "too early in the scheme of things to be really meaningful."
"As far as specifying a target of that interest, we're not simply going to comment on what has been speculated and rumored," said company spokesman Patrick Sweeney.
A Wall Street Journal report sourced to confidential Entergy documents said the New Orleans-based company was considering a 1.2 billion stg bid for London Electricity.
The Journal said the bid was assumed in the documents to be around 700 pence per share.
Sweeney, who on Monday denied a report about a possible bid for Yorkshire Electricity Plc, would not deny Tuesday's Wall Street Journal article.
London Electricity said earlier Tuesday that it had no comment.
Entergy shares were unchanged from the Monday close at 28-1/8 in New York on Tuesday.
